tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The 60%. Page background. Plum black in dark (warm, no blue, so it sits well with the neutral grey cards and the pink), soft grey in light.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The 30%. Card fill: one step lighter than bg in dark, between bg and white in light, so the white top glow shows. No strokes around cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Fields, steppers, chips, neutral buttons, segmented track, empty grid cells.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Reserved. Not used in v1 (no divider lines).

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Only the dashed outline of Add set / Add exercise rows and the drag placeholder.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and edited values on bg, surface and surface-raised (16:1+).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Subtitles, section headers, captions and SUGGESTED values on bg, surface and surface-raised (5.6:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels, inactive year-grid cells. Not for readable text.

tokens.name: pink
tokens.usage: The 10%. Primary button fill, active tab, progress fill, chart bars, trained days. Text on it is on-pink (black): white on this pink is only 4:1.

tokens.name: on-pink
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a pink fill (5.3:1).

tokens.name: pink-text
tokens.usage: Pink as text or icon: active tab label, links, PR numbers. 5.5:1+ on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: pink-tint
tokens.usage: Reserved. Not used in v1.

tokens.name: pink-soft
tokens.usage: Active tab block, ring track, unselected chart bars, icon tiles, text-selection highlight.

tokens.name: green
tokens.usage: Tertiary, celebration only: PR badge, New PR block, completed goals, progress that went up. Text on it is on-green.

tokens.name: on-green
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a green fill (14:1).

tokens.name: green-text
tokens.usage: Green as text or icon: '+2,5 kg', completed checks. 5.4:1+ on bg, surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: green-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill behind a green icon or badge.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive text and icons: Delete, Discard, Remove. Always paired with a verb.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind dialogs and the pull-up sheet.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Workout name in the Suggested / In progress card. Screen titles and the greeting use 34/40 -5% (see handoff 2.3).

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card and row titles, exercise names. Regular; hierarchy comes from size and ink colour.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Not used in v1 screens; steppers and number fields use 20/26 (see handoff 2.3).

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Every button label: 17px regular. No bold or medium anywhere.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Section headers, subtitles, tab labels, captions.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Title to subtitle.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between chips; icon to label; vertical padding of a grouped list card.

tokens.name: space-label
tokens.usage: Section label to its card; row vertical padding inside a grouped list.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gap between items inside a card.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, left and right. Cards keep 16px inside (space-3). With 24px the 310px year grid fits a card exactly.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between content and the primary button inside a card.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen; header to the first section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Large breathing room above empty-state art.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Empty-state mini-grid cells (12px cells). Year-overview cells use 1px.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, filter chips, checkbox, chart bar tops.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Reserved. Not used in v1 screens.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Selected segmented option and the stepper +/- buttons (16 minus 4 padding).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: THE radius. Every button (primary, secondary, icon, play, tab items), cards, rows, inputs, steppers, dialogs. All four corners, always.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Only the top of the pull-up sheet.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Only fully round things: toggles, progress bar.

tokens.name: shadow-bevel
tokens.usage: THE depth, replaces every border: a hard 2px inner glow on the top edge. Light adds the inverse, a faint 2px inner shade on the bottom edge. No outer shadow, no strokes.

tokens.name: shadow-button
tokens.usage: Neutral buttons (grey icon buttons, Discard, Cancel, sheet actions): 2px light top AND 2px shade bottom, also in dark. Cards keep only the top line in dark.

tokens.name: shadow-bevel-accent
tokens.usage: Pink and green fills: a bright 2px top line and a darker 2px bottom edge. No rim around the sides.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: Small neutral things: chips, filter chips, the options (...) button, unselected chart bars. 1px light on top, 1px shade below.

tokens.name: shadow-pill-accent
tokens.usage: Small elements on pink or green: PR pill, selected segmented option. Same colours as shadow-bevel-accent, at 1px.

tokens.name: shadow-nav
tokens.usage: The selected tab item: 2px light on top, 2px shade below.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Fields, steppers, segmented track, progress track, toggle track: surface-raised fill with 1px light on top and 1px shade below. Same rule as the chips, no blur.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Only floating layers: the pull-up sheet, dialogs, a dragged row.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target: stepper buttons, the x on set rows, icon buttons.

tokens.name: control-h
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, stepper fields and list rows.

tokens.name: tabbar-h
tokens.usage: Tab bar height (8 top padding + 56 item + 24 bottom), plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom) on top of this.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Outline icons, 2px stroke (bold, not hairline).
